metadata.title: Webhook API Endpoint for Spec Upload

story.iWant: a webhook endpoint to POST OpenAPI specs with API key authentication
story.soThat: specs are automatically cataloged on every deployment

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: POST /api/v1/specs/openapi endpoint accepts JSON body with query params version and environment, Authorization header
Authentication middleware validates API key: 401 for missing/invalid, 403 for revoked, metadata in request context
Spec validation service checks structure, OpenAPI version (3.0.x/3.1.x), required fields, dereferences $refs
Invalid specs return 400 with structured error: { error: { code: 'INVALID_SPEC', message, details: { errors } } }
Valid specs stored in api_versions table with api_id, version, environment, spec_json, uploaded_at, uploaded_by
API metadata extracted from OpenAPI info: name (title), team (x-team), owner (x-owner), version
Small specs (<100 endpoints) return 200 OK with { api_id, version_id, status: 'processed', endpoints_count }
Large specs (>=100 endpoints) return 202 Accepted with { api_id, version_id, job_id, status: 'queued' }
Query parameters: version (default 3.1), environment (default dev), stored as string not enum
Correlation ID (X-Request-ID) included in response headers for tracing
Rate limiting enforced (100 requests/hour per key) via API key middleware
Logging includes: API name, environment, spec size bytes, endpoint count, API key ID, correlation ID, timing

doc.title: Product Requirements Document
doc.snippet: Zero-effort integration through automated spec uploads from CI/CD pipelines. Supports multiple environments and version tracking.

doc.title: Product Requirements Document
doc.snippet: System must support 100 concurrent webhook uploads with <5s response time for typical specs. Large specs queued for async processing.

doc.title: Architecture Document
doc.snippet: POST /api/v1/specs/openapi with Bearer token auth. Returns 201 for processed specs, 202 for queued large specs. Includes jobId for async processing.

doc.title: Architecture Document
doc.snippet: Routes registered via Fastify plugins with prefix pattern. Services injected via decorators. TypeBox schemas for request validation.

doc.title: Architecture Document
doc.snippet: Environment stored as configurable string (not enum) to support diverse enterprise pipelines: dev, staging, prod, qa, canary, etc.

doc.title: Epic Definitions
doc.snippet: Webhook API endpoint accepting OpenAPI specs with API key auth. Validates, extracts metadata, stores in database. Handles sync/async processing based on size.

doc.title: Story 2.2 - OpenAPI Validation Service
doc.snippet: OpenAPIValidationService.validate() returns ValidationResult { valid, errors?, dereferenced? }. Dereferenced spec is bundled with resolved $refs, ready for storage.

artifact.reason: API key authentication hook. Validates Bearer token, returns 401/403, decorates request.apiKeyId. This story reuses this middleware.
Key validation method returning { id } or null. Auth plugin uses this. New webhook route will leverage existing auth flow.
Protected routes registration pattern with auth plugin encapsulation. New specs route should be registered in protected context.
Service plugin registration pattern. New services (metadata, storage) follow same pattern.
Reference route implementation pattern with Fastify schema validation and JSON response.
Database models for storing specs. Api has name/team/owner. ApiVersion has specJson, environment (string), uploadedBy. Endpoint stores path/method.
Prisma client instance. Storage service will use db.api and db.apiVersion for database operations.
Test pattern for auth scenarios. New webhook tests should cover similar 401/403 cases.

node.package: Core framework - route registration, schema validation, lifecycle hooks
Plugin encapsulation for services and routes
TypeBox for request/response schema definitions with TypeScript inference
Rate limiting middleware already configured (100/hour per key)
OpenAPI doc generation from route schemas
Test runner for unit and integration tests

fromStory22.package: Service to be injected via fastify.openAPIValidationService

constraints.constraint: MUST use existing API key authentication middleware from Story 1.6 (apps/api/src/plugins/auth.ts)
MUST use OpenAPIValidationService from Story 2.2 (fastify.openAPIValidationService decorator)
MUST follow Fastify route plugin pattern with schema validation
MUST provide structured error responses: { error: { code, message, details? } }
MUST NOT store plaintext API keys in logs or responses - only key ID
MUST handle both sync (<100 endpoints) and async (>=100 endpoints) processing paths
MUST store environment as string (not enum) per ADR-009
MUST use correlation IDs (request.id) for request tracing per NFR-O1
MUST NOT block on embedding generation - deferred to Story 2.4/3.2
ES modules (type: module) - use .js extensions in imports
TypeBox schemas for Fastify route validation (not Zod for routes)
Protected routes registered in app.ts protected context block

tests.standards: Vitest test runner with TypeScript support. Tests organized by describe blocks. Use beforeEach/afterEach for setup and teardown. Test files in apps/api/src/__tests__/. Integration tests use app.inject() for HTTP testing without starting server. Unit tests mock dependencies. Run with: pnpm --filter @perrache/api test. Use test fixtures from Story 2.2 in apps/api/src/__tests__/fixtures/openapi-specs/.

ideas.idea: Valid POST request with all parameters returns 200/202
Request without body returns 400 validation error
Missing Authorization header returns 401 UNAUTHORIZED
Invalid API key returns 401 UNAUTHORIZED
Revoked API key returns 401 (current impl treats as invalid)
Valid API key passes through, request.apiKeyId set
Valid spec passes validation, dereferenced returned
Invalid spec returns 400 with INVALID_SPEC error code
Validation errors include path and message for each issue
Valid spec creates ApiVersion record in database
uploadedBy field contains API key ID
specJson contains full dereferenced spec
API name extracted from info.title
Team extracted from info['x-team'] when present
Owner extracted from info['x-owner'] when present
New API record created if name not found
Existing API record found by case-insensitive name match
Spec with 99 endpoints returns 200 with status: 'processed'
Response includes correct endpoints_count
Spec with 100 endpoints returns 202 with status: 'queued'
Response includes job_id for async tracking
Default version is 3.1 when not specified
Default environment is 'dev' when not specified
Custom environment (e.g., 'staging') stored as string
Response includes X-Request-ID header
Correlation ID matches request.id
Rate limiting returns 429 when exceeded (covered by existing tests)
Log entry includes apiName field
Log entry includes environment field
Log entry includes specSizeBytes field
Log entry includes endpointsCount field
Log entry includes apiKeyId (not full key)
Log entry includes duration timing
